cacheConditions.documentationCache: the optional fetch-doc helper has no application cache; other normal retrieval paths and upstream DNS/CDN caches are not controlled

directHttpRequests.method: fetch-doc.mjs retains one entry per HTTP response or failed attempt; normal direct HTTP and extension paths remain permitted and are not fully observable

browserCommands.method: literal chrome-devtools executable/tool matches in captured bash commands and tool calls; shell loops and extension-internal activity may not map one-to-one to browser commands

jev.basis: Jev credentials were removed from trial children and the fixed protocol forbids inference; normal documentation and browser tools remain available

verification.method: fresh independent Pi context applying the fixed checklist and re-fetching cited sources

recoveryWork.reason: not separately distinguishable from ordinary work; failed tool calls are reported independently

retained.processMethod: unavailable: awaiting the direct Pi children does not establish whether they left descendants
retained.pageMethod: unavailable: normal browser access is permitted and the runner does not inspect or close pre-existing browser state

environment.resourceDiscovery: normal Pi discovery enabled for extensions, skills (including TypeSafe) and prompt templates; only repository trial files are isolated
environment.toolSelection: normal Pi defaults; the runner does not apply a tool allowlist or disable browser-capable extensions

frozenContext.method: shared context files materialized directly from the named Git object with git show

unavailableMeasurements: total browser commands across unrestricted tool paths
recovery work beyond observable failed tool calls
